expectations.text: Baseline gives direct advice without specialized frameworks
expectations.evidence: Provides 5 numbered points covering sentiment vs analysis, concentration risk, self-check questions, alternative allocation (30/30/20/10), and a guiding principle. No APIs or env vars mentioned.
Explicitly recommends against all-in, suggests DCA over lump-sum, mentions stop-loss/take-profit. Concrete numbers (30-40% index, 10% cash reserve).
